name: [Phase Shift]
source:
Boy meets girl. Boy is a cynic. Girl is just a tad bit strange and not what she seems on the surface... A friendship is born and perhaps a new phase in their lives will begin to move. But this is just a small story within a bigger picture.

[From [url=http://games.renpy.org/game/phaseshift.shtml]Ren'Py Archive[/url]]
translation:
少年遇见少女。少年愤世嫉俗，少女则有些古怪，远非表面看起来那么简单……两人由此结下友谊，人生或许也将迈入新的阶段。然而，这不过是宏大图景中的一则小故事。

[译自 [url=http://games.renpy.org/game/phaseshift.shtml]Ren'Py Archive[/url]]
